newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico CCP-dollar rate up slightly in May vs April.
newsitem.headline: Mexico CCP-dollar rate up slightly in May vs April.

text.p: Mexico's CCP-dollar rate, the average bank term deposit cost measured in dollars, was 6.65 percent in May compared to 6.63 percent in April, Banco de Mexico said on Thursday.
The central bank said that the rate can be used as a reference to determine the interest rate of credits denominated in dollars.
The monthly calculation of the CCP-dollars includes loans of foreign banks to multiple banking institutions and financing received from various export and import development banks.
